summary: Comprehensive testing of new Inventory module (Master Bahan, Barang Masuk, Sisa/Rijek + stats). Backend: 20/20 pytest tests passed. Frontend: Full end-to-end UI flow completed successfully via Playwright (login → sidebar nav → 4 stat cards → 3 tabs → create/edit material → stock-in → waste → verify stock auto-adjust + Rupiah loss estimate). All acceptance criteria met.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor (non-blocking): React hydration warning observed in browser console when opening the Stock-In modal — 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'. This is caused by the Emergent dev overlay wrapping <option> text in <span data-ve-dynamic='true'>. It is a build-time instrumentation artifact and does NOT affect functionality (select still submits correct value). No action required unless production build shows same issue.

server.py inventory module (~250 lines): logic is clean, uses uuid IDs (no Mongo ObjectId leak — verified `_id` excluded and asserted absent in test_create_material_decimal). All endpoints guarded by require_super_admin. Stock rollback on delete for both stock-in and waste is correctly implemented and verified by tests.

Suggestion (nice-to-have, not a bug): Waste rollback on delete does not check for negative stock scenarios; harmless as it only adds back the deleted quantity but if the same stock was later depleted by another waste, restoring can inflate stock beyond a physical reality. Acceptable for MVP.

Suggestion: `purchase_price` on Material is auto-overwritten to latest stock-in unit_price. This is documented behavior (verified in test) but consider surfacing this in UI copy so user isn't surprised.
